issues: Covers fell by 131 (10.58%) week on week.
Spend per head fell by £0.63 (2.82%) week on week.
Sales were £25,786, down £4,617.99 (15.18%) week on week.
Labour was 17.25% and food cost 24.37% on the BOH meeting sheet, while Abhi reported wage at about 17% and food cost at about 22%, so the figures need reconciling.
No HC meeting was held this week.
The extractor duct leak is the highest priority job: oil leaks onto the stairs, there have been near misses and staff have already slipped.
The extractor leak was reported almost two months ago, has been raised to Ka, and three contractors are coming this week to survey and quote, with a fix hoped for next week.
An investigation into a building leak is ongoing.
A site compliance service is due in two weeks.
The site needs one good chef from November to cover holidays running December to March, and Penny agreed it is better to start recruiting now.

Dessert making is using the site's space and factory cleaning is not being coordinated; Abhi has said this is outside his remit (raised with Ross, Ka, Lincoln and Michael), the dessert maker would not move to the factory, and changes are planned from January.
The site received no Google reviews this week, and reviews are the stated area for improvement.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): last week's chicken broth usage discrepancy was traced to a takeaway recipe still linked to the old tonkotsu broth in stock counts, which has been corrected, so usage should return to normal next week.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): Bidfood is being brought in as a new supplier, starting with Aberdeen and reaching the other sites within one to two months, and new beef samples are being trialled with a view to pre-cooked beef so sites no longer cook it themselves.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): frozen ramen promotion stock is delivered from the factory on 07/10, but storage space at the smaller sites is unconfirmed and the memo does not specify quantities per flavour.
